manifest.scope: All canonical ROSTER records, including military. No browser-local characters or saved outfits.
manifest.afterEvidence: Not supplied; no after images generated

characters.Name: SOL
characters.Title: Man of Sunlight
characters.Current identity / powers: A living solar reactor. Thin heat-ray, wide freezing breath, and a flight-fist that ends arguments.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Heat Ray (beam)
RMB: Arctic Breath (cone)
Q: Sky Smash (melee)
E: Solar Flare (projectile)
H: Heat Flurry (volley)
SHIFT: Super Dash (dash)

characters.Name: KANO
characters.Title: Spirit Warrior
characters.Current identity / powers: Charge the Wave Cannon like a firehose of light. Blink behind them. Then drop a sky-sized Star Sphere.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Wave Cannon (beam)
RMB: Comet Rush (rush)
Q: Ki Blast (projectile)
E: Snap Transit (teleport)
SHIFT: Flash Step (dash)
R: Star Sphere (growingorb)

characters.Name: VEGAS
characters.Title: Fallen Prince
characters.Current identity / powers: Left-right-left-right blaster storm, a size-scaling Nova Burst that cracks the ground, and the Final Arc.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Volley (volley)
RMB: Violet Lance (beam)
Q: Nova Burst (charge)
E: Rush Combo (melee)
SHIFT: Burst Dash (dash)
R: Final Arc (beam)

characters.Name: AURUM
characters.Title: The Willbearer
characters.Current identity / powers: Solid-light constructs you fly with your cursor: a rocket fist, a falling hammer, a wall, a sentry turret.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Will Fist (construct)
RMB: Will Hammer (construct)
Q: Barrier (construct)
E: Sentry (construct)
H: Emerald Bolt (projectile)
SHIFT: Will Surge (dash)

characters.Name: NOVA
characters.Title: Star Sovereign
characters.Current identity / powers: Rains stars from orbit. A precision Star Lance, a swelling Nova Core, and a sky-wide Meteor Storm.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Star Lance (beam)
RMB: Nova Core (charge)
Q: Plasma Orb (projectile)
E: Solar Wind (cone)
H: Ember Spray (volley)
SHIFT: Sun Step (dash)
R: Meteor Storm (meteor)

characters.Name: RIME
characters.Title: The Deep Cold
characters.Current identity / powers: Freezes the battlefield: breath that slows to a crawl, walls of ice, and an Absolute Zero detonation.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Frost Breath (cone)
RMB: Shard Volley (volley)
Q: Ice Wall (construct)
E: Cryo Beam (beam)
H: Glacier Spike (projectile)
SHIFT: Ice Skate (dash)
R: Absolute Zero (charge)

characters.Name: VOLT
characters.Title: The Overclock
characters.Current identity / powers: Faster than you can track. Grab him and the current bites back. Lightning flurries, arc-beams, and Overclock.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Lightning Flurry (rush)
RMB: Arc Beam (beam)
Q: Chain Bolt (projectile)
E: Static Field (cone)
H: Zap Step (teleport)
SHIFT: Blink (dash)

characters.Name: WARDEN
characters.Title: Gravity Anchor
characters.Current identity / powers: Bends weight itself. Shove crowds with force cones, drop a Singularity, then Collapse the arena.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Force Push (cone)
RMB: Graviton (projectile)
Q: Singularity (growingorb)
E: Anchor Slam (melee)
H: Phase (teleport)
SHIFT: Slide (dash)
R: Collapse (charge)

characters.Name: HIVE
characters.Title: The Conclave
characters.Current identity / powers: Never fights alone. Swarms of seeker-drones, a fixed sentinel, and an Overmind that empowers the hive.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Drone Swarm (summon)
RMB: Sentinel (construct)
Q: Formic Sting (projectile)
E: Hunter Pack (summon)
H: Scatter (cone)
SHIFT: Scramble (dash)

characters.Name: PYRE
characters.Title: Living Wildfire
characters.Current identity / powers: Walking eruption. Lobbed fireballs, a roaring flame cone, a swelling Magma Bomb, and a Rain of Fire.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Fireball (projectile)
RMB: Flamethrower (cone)
Q: Magma Bomb (charge)
E: Burning Fist (melee)
H: Cinder Burst (volley)
SHIFT: Flare Dash (dash)
R: Rain of Fire (meteor)

characters.Name: TORCH
characters.Title: The Human Flame
characters.Current identity / powers: Flame on. A fast flyer wrapped in fire — grab him and you burn. Jets, homing fireballs, and a supernova.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Flame Jet (beam)
RMB: Fire Blast (cone)
Q: Fireball (projectile)
E: Flaming Fist (melee)
H: Ember Storm (volley)
SHIFT: Jet Dash (dash)
R: Supernova (nova)

characters.Name: APEX
characters.Title: The Perfect Being
characters.Current identity / powers: A bio-engineered predator. His throws drain your life to heal him, he regenerates, and charges a perfect wave.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Wave Cannon (beam)
RMB: Tail Sweep (melee)
Q: Consume (lifedrain)
E: Afterimage (teleport)
H: Regenerate (buff)
SHIFT: Burst Step (dash)

characters.Name: SPECTER
characters.Title: The Synthezoid
characters.Current identity / powers: Controls his own density. Phase through everything with energy, or turn diamond-hard to hit like a truck.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Solar Beam (beam)
RMB: Density Punch (melee)
Q: Intangibility (phase)
E: Stone Bolt (projectile)
H: Max Density (buff)
SHIFT: Phase Step (dash)
R: Solar Nova (charge)

characters.Name: VANGUARD
characters.Title: The Invincible
characters.Current identity / powers: Bulletproof and airborne. Tackles across the sky, laser-visions from range, and turns briefly untouchable.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Eye Beam (beam)
RMB: Flying Tackle (melee)
Q: Thunderclap (cone)
E: Sky Combo (rush)
SHIFT: Blitz (dash)
R: Unbreakable (buff)

characters.Name: KRAKEN
characters.Title: The Abyss Given Form
characters.Current identity / powers: Four living tentacles grown from raw energy. They reach, they constrict — and then they slam you through the nearest wall.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Abyssal Grab (tentacle)
RMB: Riptide Lash (melee)
Q: Corrosive Ink (cone)
E: Abyss Bolt (projectile)
H: Deep Hunger (buff)
SHIFT: Surge (dash)
R: Leviathan Maw (charge)

characters.Name: RIFT
characters.Title: The Doorbreaker
characters.Current identity / powers: Opens doors in the world itself. Orange in, blue out — fighters, fireballs, everything goes through. Geometry is a suggestion.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Rift Ray (beam)
RMB: Dimensional Door (portal)
Q: Fracture Bolt (projectile)
E: Step Through (teleport)
SHIFT: Slip (dash)
R: Event Horizon (charge)

characters.Name: TITAN
characters.Title: The War Engine
characters.Current identity / powers: Not a man — a machine of war. Battery-fed twin cannons, a pulse rifle, thruster exhaust, and armor that showers sparks instead of blood.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Twin Cannon (beam)
RMB: Pulse Rifle (rifle)
Q: Reactor Burst (charge)
E: Vent Blast (cone)
SHIFT: Thruster Dash (dash)
R: Annihilator Array (beam)

characters.Name: SARGE
characters.Title: The Last Soldier
characters.Current identity / powers: No powers. Just a pulse carbine, a plasma blade, a riot shield, grenades, and legs that clear a building. Somehow still terrifying.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Service Carbine (rifle)
RMB: Frag Grenade (projectile)
Q: Plasma Blade (melee)
E: Breaching Shotgun (rifle)
H: Stim Shot (buff)
SHIFT: Combat Roll (dash)
R: Airstrike (meteor)

characters.Name: MERC
characters.Title: The Outlander
characters.Current identity / powers: A mercenary with a gun for every range and a short-range combat teleporter. Charged pistol, blaster rifle, thermal detonators — double-tap a direction to blink out of the firing line.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Blaster Rifle (rifle)
RMB: Charged Pistol (charge)
Q: Scatter Blaster (rifle)
E: Thermal Detonator (projectile)
H: Heavy Pistol (rifle)
SHIFT: Combat Roll (dash)
R: Rail Detonator (projectile)

characters.Name: KIVULI
characters.Title: The Breath of Kampala
characters.Current identity / powers: From Kampala, Uganda. Exhales a living purple gas that chokes, blinds — and turns SOLID on his command. Walls, blades, coffins of hardened vapor.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Choking Veil (cone)
RMB: Solid Smoke (construct)
Q: Gas Form (phase)
E: Creeping Cloud (projectile)
H: Second Wind (buff)
SHIFT: Vapor Slip (dash)
R: Asphyxia (charge)

characters.Name: GALE
characters.Title: The Last Ranger
characters.Current identity / powers: No powers — a bow, a knife, and a quiver of nasty ideas. Draw deep and switch broadheads: poison bleeds, flame burns, explosive erases, acid eats armour.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Longshot (bow)
RMB: Concussion Shot (projectile)
Q: Switch Broadheads (quiver)
E: Ranger Knife (melee)
H: Deadeye (buff)
SHIFT: Tumble (dash)
R: Arrow Storm (volley)

characters.Name: KING STEFANOS
characters.Title: The First Celebrity Superweapon
characters.Current identity / powers: President of Greece. His energy takes SHAPE before it strikes — jagged motes, concussive forms, and one shape he can never put down: her face, arriving slow, leaving nothing.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Formed Charge (projectile)
RMB: Mote Storm (volley)
Q: Concussive Form (cone)
E: Pressure Sphere (charge)
SHIFT: Propelled Slip (dash)
R: THE MARLETTA (facebomb)

characters.Name: SANDRA
characters.Title: The First Jackal
characters.Current identity / powers: The first Jackal. Hunts living superweapons for a living — twin pistols, a ring that sees through every camera on Earth, and a beacon she plants BEFORE the fight starts.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Twin Pistols (rifle)
RMB: Suppressed SMG (rifle)
Q: The Ring Sees (buff)
E: Pistol Whip (melee)
H: Tracker Round (projectile)
SHIFT: Slip the Frame (dash)
R: Clean Extraction (rush)

characters.Name: IRONCLAD
characters.Title: The Suit
characters.Current identity / powers: A genius in a furnace-gold shell. Repulsors, a chest unibeam, and enough thrust to argue with gravity.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Repulsor Bolts (rifle)
RMB: Unibeam (beam)
Q: Micro-Missiles (projectile)
E: Flare Vent (cone)
SHIFT: Vector Thrust (dash)
R: Housewarming Party (beam)

characters.Name: RAGE
characters.Title: The Monster in the Man
characters.Current identity / powers: The angrier he gets, the simpler the fight becomes. Strength 10. Leaps counties. Only knows haymakers.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Smash (melee)
RMB: Thunder Clap (cone)
Q: Boulder (projectile)
E: Rampage (rush)
SHIFT: Bull Charge (dash)
R: WORLD BREAKER (nova)

characters.Name: STORMCALL
characters.Title: Heir of Thunder
characters.Current identity / powers: An axe that remembers lightning. Skies answer when he shouts.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Axe Cleave (melee)
RMB: Hurled Axe (projectile)
Q: Godblast (charge)
E: Tempest Breath (cone)
SHIFT: Bolt Dash (dash)
R: SKYFALL (meteor)

characters.Name: WEBLINE
characters.Title: The Neighborhood Ghost
characters.Current identity / powers: Too fast to hit, too chatty to ignore. His webs pull you in — the wall does the rest.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Web Snare (tentacle)
RMB: Spider Flurry (rush)
Q: Web Darts (projectile)
E: Sting Kick (melee)
H: Danger Sense (buff)
SHIFT: Web Zip (grapple)

characters.Name: RIPCLAW
characters.Title: The Best At What He Does
characters.Current identity / powers: Claws, healing, and a very short temper. What he does isn't very nice.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Ripping Claws (melee)
RMB: Lunge Shred (melee)
Q: Berserker Slashes (rush)
E: Intimidate (cone)
H: Regeneration (buff)
SHIFT: Pounce Step (dash)

characters.Name: MAJESTY
characters.Title: Higher. Further. Faster.
characters.Current identity / powers: A star wearing a person. When she goes binary, look away.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Photon Stream (beam)
RMB: Star Barrage (volley)
Q: Nova Fist (charge)
E: Comet Punch (melee)
SHIFT: Light Speed (dash)
R: Supernova Lance (beam)

characters.Name: MYSTWARD
characters.Title: Keeper of the Seals
characters.Current identity / powers: Doors, wards, and sigils. He was a surgeon once; now he closes wounds in the world. The whip drinks the power right out of you.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Crimson Bands (projectile)
RMB: Seraphim Shield (construct)
Q: Fold Space (teleport)
E: Eldritch Whip (beam)
H: Vishanti Ward (buff)
SHIFT: Cloak Drift (dash)
R: Sigil Rain (meteor)

characters.Name: ONYX
characters.Title: The Kinetic King
characters.Current identity / powers: A king in a suit that drinks the hit and hands it back. Claws first, questions later.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Kinetic Claws (melee)
RMB: Hunt Sequence (rush)
Q: Kimoyo Dart (projectile)
E: Sonic Overload (cone)
H: Kinetic Release (buff)
SHIFT: Shadow Step (dash)
R: Kinetic Burst (charge)

characters.Name: CHAINFIRE
characters.Title: The Debt Collector
characters.Current identity / powers: A skull full of fire and a chain that always finds its debtor. It drags you back to the wall you owe.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Hellfire Chain (tentacle)
RMB: Soul Furnace (cone)
Q: Brimstone Ball (projectile)
E: Chain Lash (melee)
H: Penance Stare (buff)
SHIFT: Hell Ride (dash)
R: Rain of Hellfire (meteor)

characters.Name: TEMPEST
characters.Title: Weather Sovereign
characters.Current identity / powers: The forecast answers to her. Hail, gale, and lightning filed under mood.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Chain Lightning (beam)
RMB: Gale Force (cone)
Q: Hail Volley (volley)
E: Flash Freeze (cone)
H: Storm Domain (weather)
SHIFT: Tailwind (dash)
R: Stormfront (meteor)

characters.Name: KNIGHTFALL
characters.Title: The Night Itself
characters.Current identity / powers: No powers. A plan for yours, though. Grapnel to the roofline, cape-glide off it, and he is suddenly somewhere above you.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Blade Fan (volley)
RMB: Cross Counter (melee)
Q: Smoke Vanish (teleport)
E: Caustic Charges (mine)
H: Grapnel Line (grapple)
SHIFT: Cape Slip (dash)
R: Wing Support (construct)

characters.Name: AEGIS
characters.Title: Daughter of War
characters.Current identity / powers: Bracelets that hand bullets back and a golden lasso that ends arguments against the nearest wall.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: God-Forged Blade (melee)
RMB: Golden Lasso (tentacle)
Q: Aegis Wave (charge)
E: Shield Shout (cone)
SHIFT: War Stride (dash)
R: Wrath of Themyscira (charge)

characters.Name: OLYMPUS
characters.Title: The Word Made Lightning
characters.Current identity / powers: Say the word and the sky says it back. A kid's grin wearing a god's wattage.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Living Lightning (beam)
RMB: Thunder Fist (melee)
Q: Thunderbolt (charge)
E: Static Storm (volley)
SHIFT: Mercury Step (dash)
R: JUDGMENT BOLT (charge)

characters.Name: MARSHAL
characters.Title: The Last Son of a Dead World
characters.Current identity / powers: Walks through walls, reads the room literally, hits like a freight train from a world that no longer exists.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Alien Vision (beam)
RMB: Density Hammer (melee)
Q: Ghost Body (phase)
E: Mind Skip (teleport)
SHIFT: Wraith Dash (dash)
R: Dominion (mindcontrol)

characters.Name: CIRCUIT
characters.Title: Half Man, All Machine
characters.Current identity / powers: The accident left him half machine — the machine half never runs dry. BOOYAH is a technical term.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Sonic Cannon (rifle)
RMB: White Noise Beam (beam)
Q: Shock Grapple (projectile)
E: Overload Vent (cone)
SHIFT: Servo Burst (dash)
R: BOOYAH Cannon (beam)

characters.Name: TRENCH
characters.Title: King of the Drowned Court
characters.Current identity / powers: A trident, a temper, and a court of things with too many teeth that answer when he whistles.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Trident Pierce (melee)
RMB: The Drowned Court (summon)
Q: Riptide (cone)
E: Harpoon Throw (projectile)
SHIFT: Current Ride (dash)
R: MAELSTROM (growingorb)

characters.Name: DECIBEL
characters.Title: The Cry That Levels Blocks
characters.Current identity / powers: Trained fists and a voice that files buildings under rubble. You'll hear her before you see her. Everyone does.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Siren Scream (cone)
RMB: Combat Cadence (rush)
Q: Heel Turn (melee)
E: Focused Note (projectile)
SHIFT: Staccato Step (dash)

characters.Name: COLDSNAP
characters.Title: The Absolute Zero Rule
characters.Current identity / powers: Rules: plan the job, freeze the hero, walk away. The gun doesn't miss because he never hurries.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Cold Gun (rifle)
RMB: Flash Frost (cone)
Q: Glacier Wall (construct)
E: Cryo Charge (projectile)
H: Cold Read (buff)
SHIFT: Getaway (dash)
R: Absolute Frost (charge)

characters.Name: CRUCIBLE
characters.Title: The Self-Made Man of Steel
characters.Current identity / powers: Built the suit, forged the hammer, earned the S he paints on it. The hammer comes back. Eventually.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Foundry Hammer (melee)
RMB: Hammer Toss (projectile)
Q: Rivet Gun (rifle)
E: Forge Vent (cone)
SHIFT: Piston Drive (dash)
R: Orbital Forge (meteor)

characters.Name: TALON
characters.Title: The First Sidekick to Outgrow the Shadow
characters.Current identity / powers: Raised in a circus, trained by the night. Two sticks, zero fear, unreasonable hang-time.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Escrima Cross (melee)
RMB: Flying Grayson (rush)
Q: Wing-Ding Fan (volley)
E: Staff Sweep (melee)
SHIFT: Tumbler (dash)

characters.Name: ABEO
characters.Title: Shield of the Hand
characters.Current identity / powers: COF canon: Hand of Uganda LSW bodyguard. Living metal. Stands between the president and everything.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Iron Palm (melee)
RMB: Shockwave Stomp (cone)
Q: Shrapnel Fist (projectile)
E: Guard Break (melee)
SHIFT: Bulwark Rush (dash)
R: Foundation Breaker (charge)

characters.Name: JELANI
characters.Title: Spear of the Hand
characters.Current identity / powers: COF canon: Hand of Uganda bodyguard. Strength AND speed — the combination treaties were written about.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Piston Blow (melee)
RMB: Blur Assault (rush)
Q: Sonic Wake (cone)
E: Spear Tackle (melee)
H: Second Wind (buff)
SHIFT: Afterburn (dash)
R: A Hundred Hands (rush)

characters.Name: KAMARIA
characters.Title: Veil of the Hand
characters.Current identity / powers: COF canon: Hand of Uganda bodyguard. Assassins' blades pass through her; hers do not return the courtesy.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Veiled Edge (melee)
RMB: Untouchable (phase)
Q: Veil Step (teleport)
E: Phase Bolt (projectile)
H: Half-Here (buff)
SHIFT: Slip Veil (dash)
R: Ten Veils (rush)

characters.Name: RAMIRO
characters.Title: The Clown-Sheriff
characters.Current identity / powers: COF canon: a heavyset cop in clown makeup who terrorizes the cartels one district at a time. "My son has to go home."
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Riot Scattergun (rifle)
RMB: Service Revolver (rifle)
Q: Nightstick (melee)
E: Gas Canister (projectile)
SHIFT: Duck & Cover (dash)
R: Backup Called (summon)

characters.Name: JAWAH MATU
characters.Title: The Silence
characters.Current identity / powers: COF canon: absorbs sound through exposed skin. Your scream, your gunshot, your charge-up roar — he eats them all and grows stronger.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Absorption Field (cone)
RMB: Dead-Air Palm (melee)
Q: Null Wave (projectile)
E: Returned Thunder (cone)
SHIFT: Hush (dash)
R: EVERY SOUND AT ONCE (charge)

characters.Name: MOSES APIO
characters.Title: The Atlas Protocol
characters.Current identity / powers: COF canon: a young Mbarara mechanic bonded to the Atlas Protocol symbiont — it watches, it regenerates, it reaches.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Atlas Tendrils (tentacle)
RMB: Symbiont Fist (melee)
Q: Protocol Surge (rush)
E: Bio Spike (projectile)
H: Regenerative Bond (buff)
SHIFT: Adaptive Slip (dash)

characters.Name: DUNE
characters.Title: The Walking Sahara
characters.Current identity / powers: Original: every grain within a mile answers to him. Walls, fists, storms — the desert is a toolbox.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Sandblast (cone)
RMB: Sand Rampart (construct)
Q: Fist of the Waste (projectile)
E: Dust Sentry (construct)
SHIFT: Grain Drift (dash)
R: SANDSTORM (meteor)

characters.Name: GRAVEN
characters.Title: The Weight of the World
characters.Current identity / powers: Original: gravity is his native language. He levitates because falling is optional — and his wells swallow the battlefield.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Gravity Shear (cone)
RMB: Event Well (growingorb)
Q: Dense Star (projectile)
E: Displacement (teleport)
H: Zero-G Field (buff)
SHIFT: Slingshot (dash)
R: SINGULARITY SEED (charge)

characters.Name: BULWARK
characters.Title: The Living Rampart
characters.Current identity / powers: Original: a one-man fortification. His barrier covers a squad, his walls rewrite the map, and he does not move unless he chooses to.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Rampart Fist (melee)
RMB: Bastion Wall (construct)
Q: Repulse Field (cone)
E: Watchtower (construct)
H: Hold the Line (buff)
SHIFT: Advance (dash)
R: SIEGE END (charge)

characters.Name: FERAL
characters.Title: The Reclaimed
characters.Current identity / powers: Original: they made him a weapon; the wild took him back. Claws, hide like barbed wire, and a roar that moves crowds.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Rend (melee)
RMB: Pack Hunt (rush)
Q: Apex Roar (cone)
E: Savage Lunge (melee)
SHIFT: Predator Weave (dash)
R: NO CAGES (rush)

characters.Name: BREACH
characters.Title: Entry Team
characters.Current identity / powers: [PROPOSED] An armored entry specialist. Flechettes control close range, a concussive launcher opens space, and the shield holds a frontal line. Flank or grab the shield; make the shotgun chase you.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Breach Shotgun (rifle)
RMB: Concussion Launcher (projectile)
Q: Shield Check (melee)
E: Entry Charge (mine)
H: Field Dressing (buff)
SHIFT: Entry Roll (dash)
R: Demolition Round (projectile)

characters.Name: RECON
characters.Title: Long Sight
characters.Current identity / powers: [PROPOSED] A mobile rifle scout. Fast blaster fire, a charged sidearm and a deliberate marksman shot reward clean aim. Jump jets buy brief altitude, not permanent flight; a close fighter can overwhelm the light armor.
characters.Current abilities:
LMB: Scout Blaster (rifle)
RMB: Charged Sidearm (charge)
Q: Scoped Marksman Rifle (rifle)
E: Scout Grenade (projectile)
H: Trauma Patch (buff)
SHIFT: Scout Roll (dash)
R: Anti-Armor Rocket (projectile)

rawDefinitions.name: SOL
rawDefinitions.title: Man of Sunlight
rawDefinitions.blurb: A living solar reactor. Thin heat-ray, wide freezing breath, and a flight-fist that ends arguments.

rawDefinitions.name: KANO
rawDefinitions.title: Spirit Warrior
rawDefinitions.blurb: Charge the Wave Cannon like a firehose of light. Blink behind them. Then drop a sky-sized Star Sphere.

rawDefinitions.name: VEGAS
rawDefinitions.title: Fallen Prince
rawDefinitions.blurb: Left-right-left-right blaster storm, a size-scaling Nova Burst that cracks the ground, and the Final Arc.

rawDefinitions.name: AURUM
rawDefinitions.title: The Willbearer
rawDefinitions.blurb: Solid-light constructs you fly with your cursor: a rocket fist, a falling hammer, a wall, a sentry turret.

rawDefinitions.name: NOVA
rawDefinitions.title: Star Sovereign
rawDefinitions.blurb: Rains stars from orbit. A precision Star Lance, a swelling Nova Core, and a sky-wide Meteor Storm.

rawDefinitions.name: RIME
rawDefinitions.title: The Deep Cold
rawDefinitions.blurb: Freezes the battlefield: breath that slows to a crawl, walls of ice, and an Absolute Zero detonation.

rawDefinitions.name: VOLT
rawDefinitions.title: The Overclock
rawDefinitions.blurb: Faster than you can track. Grab him and the current bites back. Lightning flurries, arc-beams, and Overclock.

rawDefinitions.name: WARDEN
rawDefinitions.title: Gravity Anchor
rawDefinitions.blurb: Bends weight itself. Shove crowds with force cones, drop a Singularity, then Collapse the arena.

rawDefinitions.name: HIVE
rawDefinitions.title: The Conclave
rawDefinitions.blurb: Never fights alone. Swarms of seeker-drones, a fixed sentinel, and an Overmind that empowers the hive.

rawDefinitions.name: PYRE
rawDefinitions.title: Living Wildfire
rawDefinitions.blurb: Walking eruption. Lobbed fireballs, a roaring flame cone, a swelling Magma Bomb, and a Rain of Fire.

rawDefinitions.name: TORCH
rawDefinitions.title: The Human Flame
rawDefinitions.blurb: Flame on. A fast flyer wrapped in fire — grab him and you burn. Jets, homing fireballs, and a supernova.
sig: R SUPERNOVA (the whole tank, one blast)

rawDefinitions.name: APEX
rawDefinitions.title: The Perfect Being
rawDefinitions.blurb: A bio-engineered predator. His throws drain your life to heal him, he regenerates, and charges a perfect wave.

rawDefinitions.name: SPECTER
rawDefinitions.title: The Synthezoid
rawDefinitions.blurb: Controls his own density. Phase through everything with energy, or turn diamond-hard to hit like a truck.

rawDefinitions.name: VANGUARD
rawDefinitions.title: The Invincible
rawDefinitions.blurb: Bulletproof and airborne. Tackles across the sky, laser-visions from range, and turns briefly untouchable.

rawDefinitions.name: KRAKEN
rawDefinitions.title: The Abyss Given Form
rawDefinitions.blurb: Four living tentacles grown from raw energy. They reach, they constrict — and then they slam you through the nearest wall.

rawDefinitions.name: RIFT
rawDefinitions.title: The Doorbreaker
rawDefinitions.blurb: Opens doors in the world itself. Orange in, blue out — fighters, fireballs, everything goes through. Geometry is a suggestion.
sig: RMB Dimensional Door (place orange, then blue)

rawDefinitions.name: TITAN
rawDefinitions.title: The War Engine
rawDefinitions.blurb: Not a man — a machine of war. Battery-fed twin cannons, a pulse rifle, thruster exhaust, and armor that showers sparks instead of blood.

rawDefinitions.name: SARGE
rawDefinitions.title: The Last Soldier
rawDefinitions.blurb: No powers. Just a pulse carbine, a plasma blade, a riot shield, grenades, and legs that clear a building. Somehow still terrifying.
sig: G Frag Grenade · Q Jump Jets (PowerWorld)

rawDefinitions.name: MERC
rawDefinitions.title: The Outlander
rawDefinitions.blurb: A mercenary with a gun for every range and a short-range combat teleporter. Charged pistol, blaster rifle, thermal detonators — double-tap a direction to blink out of the firing line.

rawDefinitions.name: KIVULI
rawDefinitions.title: The Breath of Kampala
rawDefinitions.blurb: From Kampala, Uganda. Exhales a living purple gas that chokes, blinds — and turns SOLID on his command. Walls, blades, coffins of hardened vapor.
sig: LMB Choking Veil (gas cone, lingering damage)
RMB Solid Smoke (gas hardens into a wall)

rawDefinitions.name: GALE
rawDefinitions.title: The Last Ranger
rawDefinitions.blurb: No powers — a bow, a knife, and a quiver of nasty ideas. Draw deep and switch broadheads: poison bleeds, flame burns, explosive erases, acid eats armour.

rawDefinitions.name: KING STEFANOS
rawDefinitions.title: The First Celebrity Superweapon
rawDefinitions.blurb: President of Greece. His energy takes SHAPE before it strikes — jagged motes, concussive forms, and one shape he can never put down: her face, arriving slow, leaving nothing.
sig: R THE MARLETTA (charge → homing face → delayed detonation)

rawDefinitions.name: SANDRA
rawDefinitions.title: The First Jackal
rawDefinitions.blurb: The first Jackal. Hunts living superweapons for a living — twin pistols, a ring that sees through every camera on Earth, and a beacon she plants BEFORE the fight starts.
sig: X Extraction Beacon (plant → recall to it)

rawDefinitions.name: IRONCLAD
rawDefinitions.title: The Suit
rawDefinitions.blurb: A genius in a furnace-gold shell. Repulsors, a chest unibeam, and enough thrust to argue with gravity.

rawDefinitions.name: RAGE
rawDefinitions.title: The Monster in the Man
rawDefinitions.blurb: The angrier he gets, the simpler the fight becomes. Strength 10. Leaps counties. Only knows haymakers.

rawDefinitions.name: STORMCALL
rawDefinitions.title: Heir of Thunder
rawDefinitions.blurb: An axe that remembers lightning. Skies answer when he shouts.

rawDefinitions.name: WEBLINE
rawDefinitions.title: The Neighborhood Ghost
rawDefinitions.blurb: Too fast to hit, too chatty to ignore. His webs pull you in — the wall does the rest.

rawDefinitions.name: RIPCLAW
rawDefinitions.title: The Best At What He Does
rawDefinitions.blurb: Claws, healing, and a very short temper. What he does isn't very nice.

rawDefinitions.name: MAJESTY
rawDefinitions.title: Higher. Further. Faster.
rawDefinitions.blurb: A star wearing a person. When she goes binary, look away.

rawDefinitions.name: MYSTWARD
rawDefinitions.title: Keeper of the Seals
rawDefinitions.blurb: Doors, wards, and sigils. He was a surgeon once; now he closes wounds in the world. The whip drinks the power right out of you.

rawDefinitions.name: ONYX
rawDefinitions.title: The Kinetic King
rawDefinitions.blurb: A king in a suit that drinks the hit and hands it back. Claws first, questions later.

rawDefinitions.name: CHAINFIRE
rawDefinitions.title: The Debt Collector
rawDefinitions.blurb: A skull full of fire and a chain that always finds its debtor. It drags you back to the wall you owe.

rawDefinitions.name: TEMPEST
rawDefinitions.title: Weather Sovereign
rawDefinitions.blurb: The forecast answers to her. Hail, gale, and lightning filed under mood.

rawDefinitions.name: KNIGHTFALL
rawDefinitions.title: The Night Itself
rawDefinitions.blurb: No powers. A plan for yours, though. Grapnel to the roofline, cape-glide off it, and he is suddenly somewhere above you.

rawDefinitions.name: AEGIS
rawDefinitions.title: Daughter of War
rawDefinitions.blurb: Bracelets that hand bullets back and a golden lasso that ends arguments against the nearest wall.

rawDefinitions.name: OLYMPUS
rawDefinitions.title: The Word Made Lightning
rawDefinitions.blurb: Say the word and the sky says it back. A kid's grin wearing a god's wattage.

rawDefinitions.name: MARSHAL
rawDefinitions.title: The Last Son of a Dead World
rawDefinitions.blurb: Walks through walls, reads the room literally, hits like a freight train from a world that no longer exists.

rawDefinitions.name: CIRCUIT
rawDefinitions.title: Half Man, All Machine
rawDefinitions.blurb: The accident left him half machine — the machine half never runs dry. BOOYAH is a technical term.

rawDefinitions.name: TRENCH
rawDefinitions.title: King of the Drowned Court
rawDefinitions.blurb: A trident, a temper, and a court of things with too many teeth that answer when he whistles.

rawDefinitions.name: DECIBEL
rawDefinitions.title: The Cry That Levels Blocks
rawDefinitions.blurb: Trained fists and a voice that files buildings under rubble. You'll hear her before you see her. Everyone does.

rawDefinitions.name: COLDSNAP
rawDefinitions.title: The Absolute Zero Rule
rawDefinitions.blurb: Rules: plan the job, freeze the hero, walk away. The gun doesn't miss because he never hurries.

rawDefinitions.name: CRUCIBLE
rawDefinitions.title: The Self-Made Man of Steel
rawDefinitions.blurb: Built the suit, forged the hammer, earned the S he paints on it. The hammer comes back. Eventually.

rawDefinitions.name: TALON
rawDefinitions.title: The First Sidekick to Outgrow the Shadow
rawDefinitions.blurb: Raised in a circus, trained by the night. Two sticks, zero fear, unreasonable hang-time.

rawDefinitions.name: ABEO
rawDefinitions.title: Shield of the Hand
rawDefinitions.blurb: COF canon: Hand of Uganda LSW bodyguard. Living metal. Stands between the president and everything.

rawDefinitions.name: JELANI
rawDefinitions.title: Spear of the Hand
rawDefinitions.blurb: COF canon: Hand of Uganda bodyguard. Strength AND speed — the combination treaties were written about.

rawDefinitions.name: KAMARIA
rawDefinitions.title: Veil of the Hand
rawDefinitions.blurb: COF canon: Hand of Uganda bodyguard. Assassins' blades pass through her; hers do not return the courtesy.

rawDefinitions.name: RAMIRO
rawDefinitions.title: The Clown-Sheriff
rawDefinitions.blurb: COF canon: a heavyset cop in clown makeup who terrorizes the cartels one district at a time. "My son has to go home."

rawDefinitions.name: JAWAH MATU
rawDefinitions.title: The Silence
rawDefinitions.blurb: COF canon: absorbs sound through exposed skin. Your scream, your gunshot, your charge-up roar — he eats them all and grows stronger.

rawDefinitions.name: MOSES APIO
rawDefinitions.title: The Atlas Protocol
rawDefinitions.blurb: COF canon: a young Mbarara mechanic bonded to the Atlas Protocol symbiont — it watches, it regenerates, it reaches.

rawDefinitions.name: DUNE
rawDefinitions.title: The Walking Sahara
rawDefinitions.blurb: Original: every grain within a mile answers to him. Walls, fists, storms — the desert is a toolbox.

rawDefinitions.name: GRAVEN
rawDefinitions.title: The Weight of the World
rawDefinitions.blurb: Original: gravity is his native language. He levitates because falling is optional — and his wells swallow the battlefield.

rawDefinitions.name: BULWARK
rawDefinitions.title: The Living Rampart
rawDefinitions.blurb: Original: a one-man fortification. His barrier covers a squad, his walls rewrite the map, and he does not move unless he chooses to.

rawDefinitions.name: FERAL
rawDefinitions.title: The Reclaimed
rawDefinitions.blurb: Original: they made him a weapon; the wild took him back. Claws, hide like barbed wire, and a roar that moves crowds.

rawDefinitions.name: BREACH
rawDefinitions.title: Entry Team
rawDefinitions.blurb: [PROPOSED] An armored entry specialist. Flechettes control close range, a concussive launcher opens space, and the shield holds a frontal line. Flank or grab the shield; make the shotgun chase you.
sig: C frontal shield · G clinch / throw

rawDefinitions.name: RECON
rawDefinitions.title: Long Sight
rawDefinitions.blurb: [PROPOSED] A mobile rifle scout. Fast blaster fire, a charged sidearm and a deliberate marksman shot reward clean aim. Jump jets buy brief altitude, not permanent flight; a close fighter can overwhelm the light armor.
sig: Scoped rifle: hold RMB aim · LMB fire · R reload
G grenade · C crouch · Z prone
